options.name: access_token
options.description: An OAuth2 access token if credential type is accesstoken.

options.name: auth_kind
options.description: The type of credential used.

options.name: clustering
options.description: One or more fields on which data should be clustered. Only top-level, non-repeated, simple-type fields are supported. When you cluster a table using multiple columns, the order of columns you specify is important. The order of the specified columns determines the sort order of the data.

options.name: dataset
options.description: Name of the dataset.

options.name: description
options.description: A user-friendly description of the dataset.

options.name: encryption_configuration
options.description: Custom encryption configuration.

options.name: env_type
options.description: Specifies which Ansible environment you're running this module within. This should not be set unless you know what you're doing. This only alters the User Agent string for any API requests.

options.name: expiration_time
options.description: The time when this table expires, in milliseconds since the epoch. If not present, the table will persist indefinitely.

options.name: external_data_configuration
options.description: Describes the data format, location, and other properties of a table stored outside of BigQuery. By defining these properties, the data source can then be queried as if it were a standard BigQuery table.

options.name: friendly_name
options.description: A descriptive name for this table.

options.name: labels
options.description: The labels associated with this dataset. You can use these to organize and group your datasets .

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the table.

options.name: num_rows
options.description: The number of rows of data in this table, excluding any data in the streaming buffer.

options.name: project
options.description: The Google Cloud Platform project to use.

options.name: schema
options.description: Describes the schema of this table.

options.name: scopes
options.description: Array of scopes to be used

options.name: service_account_contents
options.description: The contents of a Service Account JSON file, either in a dictionary or as a JSON string that represents it.

options.name: service_account_email
options.description: An optional service account email address if machineaccount is selected and the user does not wish to use the default email.

options.name: service_account_file
options.description: The path of a Service Account JSON file if serviceaccount is selected as type.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the given object should exist in GCP

options.name: table_reference
options.description: Reference describing the ID of this table.

options.name: time_partitioning
options.description: If specified, configures time-based partitioning for this table.

options.name: view
options.description: The view definition.
